subject.title: Add a Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as the public metadata-only manifest contract for Computer Use provider discovery?
rationale: The request is useful and aligned with manifest-first plugin discovery, but it creates public plugin API surface tied to security-sensitive macOS permission binding semantics that automation should not finalize alone.

options.title: Adopt the metadata-only contract
options.body: Proceed through the linked PR after confirming field names, docs, tests, registry/status propagation, and that metadata is not treated as authorization.

options.title: Pause for host-binding design
options.body: Keep the issue open until macOS host discovery and trust semantics are firm enough to freeze a manifest contract.

options.title: Reject this manifest surface
options.body: Close the direction and keep Computer Use discovery in existing plugin, MCP, or Codex-specific setup paths instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt the metadata-only contract
recommendation.body: Proceed through the linked PR after confirming field names, docs, tests, registry/status propagation, and that metadata is not treated as authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa opened the maintainer-labeled tracker and authored the linked implementation PR for the exact contract being decided.
